purpose: Bounded interim authorization when the provider screenshot supplies a cumulative lower bound but does not supply a measurement cutoff or reset timezone.

accounting_policy.credential_scope: Use the operator-confirmed exclusive-credential model; this is not independent provider verification.
accounting_policy.screenshot_role: Conservative lower-bound evidence only; it is never the continuously updated request counter.
accounting_policy.initial_seed: 554 plus every October SQL permit amount observed through the actual bootstrap approval time, including confirmed, conservative-uncertain, and pending permits.
accounting_policy.double_counting_rule: Adding the complete local ledger is deliberately allowed to overcount requests that may already be represented by 554; no local permit may be omitted.
accounting_policy.continuous_rule: After the stored local ledger cutoff, authorization adds only genuinely new permit rows with ReservedAtUtc strictly after that cutoff and no later than the authorization time.
accounting_policy.external_usage: No separate external reservation is assumed beyond the exclusive-credential attestation; any contrary evidence stops authorization immediately.

validity_policy.latest_stop_reason: Policy stop safely before the earliest possible civil-time November transition under the unknown reset timezone; it is not a claim about MDD's actual billing boundary.
no_extension_without: verified provider billing-period timezone and UTC boundaries

mandatory_stop_conditions: SQL connectivity or durable permit finalization is unavailable
the next authorization would reach or exceed the applicable approved boundary
the SQL ledger, permit totals, or reconciliation counters are inconsistent
unexpected provider-wide usage or another consumer is discovered
a pending permit cannot be conservatively recovered
the month-transition stop boundary is reached

operator_must_accept: intentional conservative overcounting of any local permits already represented by the screenshot
the maximum validity window and hard stop boundary
fail-closed behavior for SQL, permit, counter, and external-usage anomalies

activation_effect: This proposal does not authorize SQL registration, LaunchAgent activation, MDD requests, or any change to the retired Legacy7 state.
